description: Sophia Script for Windows (Windows 11 Enterprise LTSC 2024, PowerShell 5.1). The most advanced PowerShell module on GitHub for fine-tuning Windows and automating routine tasks.
notes: This package provides Sophia Script for Windows 11 Enterprise LTSC 2024, PowerShell 5.1 only.
Other editions: sophia-script, sophia-script-ps7, sophia-script-ltsc2024-ps7, sophia-script-win10, sophia-script-win10-ps7, sophia-script-ltsc2019, sophia-script-ltsc2021.
The Sophia and SophiaScript commands always run Sophia.ps1 in Windows PowerShell 5.1 (powershell.exe).

Run Sophia or SophiaScript in an elevated terminal (Run as administrator): Windows PowerShell, PowerShell 7 or CMD. The preset stops without administrator rights. It also stops in the VS Code terminal and in PowerShell ISE.

Sophia.ps1 is the preset. Edit "$dir\Sophia.ps1" before you run Sophia: select the functions you want. Your selections in it are not kept on update. Keep your own copy of the edited file and use it after each update.
pre_install: abort "This package is for Windows 11 Enterprise LTSC 2024, PowerShell 5.1. Detected: $ProductName (build $Build). Run 'scoop search sophia-script' to pick the right edition."
